adjudication_summary: Source re-review resolved the malformed activity extraction and database-conflict ticket for this paper. Main-text Tables 1 and 2 are now row-level activity/toxicity/HDAC IC50 records; supplement XLS/DOCX tables were opened and retained as raw parsed support; DBAASP assay values match Table 1 after nM-to-µM conversion while the exact nonribosomal database sequence remains database-only for this current paper.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP literature and assay rows are reconciled to current-paper metadata and Table 1 assay values. The exact database nonribosomal sequence is not in the current paper, so identity remains database_only_no_primary_source as a caution rather than being promoted to source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML Table 1 supplies EC50/CC50 rows for all six inhibitors and Table 2 supplies the full RMD/VOR/PNB-by-HDAC IC50 matrix. The prior malformed Table 2 extraction is resolved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is constrained to HDAC inhibition and HIV latency reversal evidence; no antimicrobial membrane/killing mechanism is inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: No blocking rework remains after source review. Cautions are preserved explicitly, so the paper is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Current paper names RMD/romidepsin/Istodax and describes it as a cyclic peptide from Chromobacterium violaceum, but does not give the exact DBAASP nonribosomal sequence string.
The activity evidence in this paper is HIV latency reversal, HDAC inhibition, and CD4 T-cell cytotoxicity, not bacterial AMP MIC activity.
TIF figures were checked through captions/package inventory; exact plotted values were not used when structured XML/XLS/DOCX tables provided the recordable numeric evidence.
